The provided documents don't say what exit code `promptfoo eval` returns when a test fails, so I don't know the answer from them.

The closest reference is a GitLab CI example that checks the failure count itself. It doesn't show promptfoo's exit behavior: "if jq -e '.results.stats.failures > 0' output.json; then" [promptfoo/site/docs/integrations/gitlab-ci.md]. That script calls `exit 1` on its own when failures exist, so the example doesn't establish whether `promptfoo eval` exits non-zero by default.

To find out, you could check the command-line reference at promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md or run a small failing eval and print `$LASTEXITCODE` (PowerShell) or `$?` (Bash).
